scandal_summary: Enron collapsed in December 2001, just 10 months after receiving a clean audit opinion from Arthur Andersen. The company had hidden billions of dollars in debt and losses in special-purpose entities (SPEs) controlled by its own CFO, Andrew Fastow. Revenue was inflated by gross-up accounting of derivative contracts. Andersen was simultaneously the auditor AND the internal audit outsourcer AND a major tax/consulting provider ($52M total: $25M audit + $27M consulting) — a severe independence threat.
key_red_flags_that_should_have_been_rais: SPEs controlled by the CFO — Note 14 related-party disclosures on CFO-run partnerships were a direct, material conflict of interest and should have triggered an independence red flag
Revenue tripled in two years ($13.3B -> $40.1B -> $100.8B) via gross-up accounting on derivatives — aggressive revenue recognition policy
Heavy reliance on financing cash flow and sales of assets to unconsolidated affiliates ($1.2B proceeds) — circularity between operating and financing activities
Net income $979M but cash flow from operations only $4.8B against $100.8B revenue — weak cash conversion ratio relative to reported profits
Andersen provided $27M of consulting alongside $25M audit — fee structure created economic dependence on the client
16-year auditor tenure combined with consulting relationship — long tenure + cross-selling indicates a compromised independence posture
CFO compensation via 'affiliated partnerships' not quantified in proxy — opacity around management compensation
Equity earnings of $425M from unconsolidated SPEs — quality of earnings concern; earnings backed by off-balance-sheet entities
Single analyst who downgraded was reassigned — management tone at the top signals suppression of dissent

expected_judgement_axes.evidence_sufficiency: Sufficient to qualify or worse — the related-party disclosures alone justified a qualified opinion on the fairness of presentation.
expected_judgement_axes.independence_concern: Critical — auditor was also internal auditor and major consultant; independence was structurally impaired.
expected_judgement_axes.going_concern: In hindsight warranted; clean opinion was indefensible.
